t: Add 2 tomatoes and 2 chillies. Tomatoes chopped, green chillies slit. Stir and cook till mushy.
Chop everything now: onions, tomatoes, green chillies, and garlic for the tadka.

Dal, 1 of 3

Dal. Turn off the flame. Let the pressure drop by itself, about 10 min. Don't open the lid yet.
Dinner's ready. Check that all three flames are off. Tell me anything you'd change, and I'll save it with the recipe.
Garnish and serve. 4 tablespoon coriander and a squeeze of lemon on the dal. Fluff the rice with a fork.
Line up the tadka. It moves fast once the ghee is hot. Ghee, jeera, garlic, dried red chillies, then hing and chilli powder.
Mash the dal, add the masala. Whisk the dal smooth, stir in the masala and ½ cup hot water. Simmer 5 min.
Pressure cook the dal: 3 whistles. Dal, 3 cups water, ½ teaspoon haldi and 1 teaspoon salt. Lid on, medium flame.
Rinse and soak the rice. 1½ cups basmati, rinsed 3 times, then covered with water.
Rinse the dal 3 times. 1 cup toor dal, until the water runs almost clear.
Salt, 1 teaspoon
Sauté 2 onions till golden. Chopped, into 1 tablespoon hot ghee, on a medium flame.
Start the rice. 2 teaspoon ghee, 1 teaspoon jeera, bay leaves (2). Then the drained rice, 3 cups water, 1 teaspoon salt. Boil, then lowest flame, lid on.
The cooker is still cooling, about 10 min. I'll tell you when it's safe to open.
